name: Tap The Rat
author: Addicting Games
description: Tap the rat is a free online puzzle game. the rats are everywhere. The rats have invaded and only your pretty kitty can stop them. Smash the rats a fat as you can and don't them overwhelm you. Thee snarling little gnat are trying to spread disease and teal your precious cheese in this adorable, fast-paced game of action, intrigue, and the inevitably of hierarchy. People own cats, and cats own the mice. Smash, mah smash your way through a never-ending level and protect the cheese. If you think being a cat just mean lying around, soaking up the sun, flicking your tail and licking your paws: THINK AGAIN! In this exciting and free mobile game, you'll be put to work as you smash rats, protect the cheese and save the day!
